T: Sharks in the pool. Rum on the terrace.
D: SPECTRE steals two atomic bombs and Bond follows the trail to Nassau.
P: Serve the snacks when Bond first meets Domino underwater on the reef off Nassau.
S: Bahamian fritters from the dock market, made with prawns

Chop 400g peeled raw prawns. Whisk 150g plain flour, 1 tsp baking powder, salt, an egg and 125ml milk into a thick batter and stir in the prawns, half a diced green capsicum and onion, a diced celery stick, a chopped chilli and a tsp of thyme. Fry spoonfuls in oil at 180C for 3 to 4 minutes until golden. Serve with mayonnaise mixed with tomato sauce, chilli sauce and lime.
the clinic diet Bond is put on, before he finds better things to do

Blitz 200g Greek yoghurt, 2 tbsp mayonnaise, a bunch each of parsley and chives, half a bunch of basil, the juice of a lemon, a garlic clove and salt until green and smooth, then chill for 30 minutes. Cut 2 carrots, 2 cucumbers, 4 celery sticks and a red capsicum into sticks, trim a bunch of radishes and crisp in iced water for 10 minutes. Drain and serve around the dip.
M: Palmyra grilled lobster tails with Bahamian baked macaroni
Largo's terrace, with the sharks circling in the pool below

Cook 300g macaroni until almost done. Whisk 2 eggs, a tin of evaporated milk, 200g grated tasty cheese, diced capsicum and onion, cayenne, salt, pepper and 20g melted butter, stir in the pasta, top with 50g more cheese and bake at 180C for 40 minutes. Melt 80g butter with 3 garlic cloves, a lime's zest and juice and paprika. Split 4 lobster tails lengthways, brush with the butter and grill for 6 to 8 minutes, basting, until just opaque. Serve with the macaroni and parsley.
4 raw lobster tails, or 8 Moreton Bay bugs@Seafood
W: Nassau guava duff with rum butter sauce
the Bahamas' own pudding, for the night of the Junkanoo parade

Rub 60g butter into 250g flour, 2 tsp baking powder, salt and 2 tbsp sugar, add an egg and 125ml milk and roll out to 25 x 30cm. Spread with 250g guava paste warmed with water, cinnamon and nutmeg, roll up, wrap in buttered paper and foil and steam for 75 minutes. Melt 80g butter with 100g brown sugar, bubble with 80ml cream and stir in 2 tbsp dark rum. Slice the duff and pour over the sauce.

dishes.make_ahead: Dice the vegetables and mix the dipping sauce up to 1 day ahead; mix the batter and fry just before serving

steps.text: Chop the prawns into small pieces.
Whisk the flour, baking powder, salt, egg and milk into a thick batter.
Stir in the prawns, capsicum, onion, celery, chilli and thyme.
Mix the mayonnaise, tomato sauce, chilli sauce and a squeeze of the lime for the dipping sauce.
Heat the oil to 180C in a deep heavy pan.
Fry heaped spoonfuls in batches for 3 to 4 minutes, turning, until golden and cooked through. Drain on paper towel.
Serve hot with the dipping sauce and the rest of the lime in wedges.

dishes.make_ahead: Blitz and chill the dip for at least 30 minutes, up to 2 days ahead; cut the vegetables up to 4 hours ahead and keep them in iced water

steps.text: Blitz the yoghurt, mayonnaise, parsley, chives, basil leaves, lemon juice, garlic and salt until green and smooth.
Chill the dip for 30 minutes.
Cut the carrots, cucumbers, celery and capsicum into sticks, trim the radishes and crisp in iced water for 10 minutes.

dishes.n: Palmyra grilled lobster tails with Bahamian baked macaroni
dishes.make_ahead: Bake the macaroni up to 1 day ahead and reheat covered at 170C; make the garlic butter ahead and grill the lobster just before serving

ingredients.item: raw lobster tails, or 8 Moreton Bay bugs

steps.text: Heat the oven to 180C. Cook the macaroni in salted water for 2 minutes less than the packet says and drain.

Whisk the eggs, evaporated milk, 200g of the cheese, the capsicum, onion, cayenne, salt, pepper and melted butter for the macaroni. Stir in the macaroni, tip into a baking dish and top with the rest of the cheese.
Bake for 40 minutes until set and golden, then rest for 10 minutes.
Melt the butter for the garlic butter with the garlic, the zest and juice of the lime and the paprika.
Split the lobster tails lengthways through the shell with a heavy knife and brush the flesh with the garlic butter.
Grill flesh side up under a hot grill or on a barbecue for 6 to 8 minutes, basting, until just opaque.
Scatter with parsley and serve with the macaroni.

veg.n: Palmyra grilled king oyster mushrooms with Bahamian baked macaroni
veg.make_ahead: Bake the macaroni up to 1 day ahead and reheat covered at 170C; make the garlic butter ahead and grill the lobster just before serving

steps.text: Heat the oven to 180C. Cook the macaroni in salted water for 2 minutes less than the packet says and drain.

Whisk the eggs, evaporated milk, 200g of the cheese, the capsicum, onion, cayenne, salt, pepper and melted butter for the macaroni. Stir in the macaroni, tip into a baking dish and top with the rest of the cheese.
Bake for 40 minutes until set and golden, then rest for 10 minutes.
Melt the butter for the garlic butter with the garlic, the zest and juice of the lime and the paprika.
Halve the mushrooms lengthways, score the cut sides in a fine criss-cross and brush with the garlic butter.
Grill cut side up under a hot grill or on a barbecue for 8 minutes, basting, until tender and browned.
Scatter with parsley and serve with the macaroni.

dishes.n: Nassau guava duff with rum butter sauce
dishes.make_ahead: Steam up to 1 day ahead, keep chilled in its foil and resteam for 20 minutes; make the sauce on the night

ingredients.item: plain flour, plus extra for rolling
cold butter, diced, plus extra for the paper

steps.text: Rub the cold butter into the flour, baking powder, salt and sugar, then stir in the egg and milk to a soft dough.
Roll out on floured baking paper to a 25 x 30cm rectangle.
Warm the guava paste with the water, cinnamon and nutmeg until spreadable, then spread over the dough leaving a 2cm border.
Roll up from a long side, wrap loosely in buttered baking paper, then foil, and twist the ends.
Steam on a rack in a covered pot over simmering water for 75 minutes, topping up the water.
For the sauce, melt the butter and brown sugar, stir in the cream and bubble for 2 minutes. Off the heat, stir in the rum.
Rest the duff for 5 minutes, unwrap, slice thickly and pour over the sauce.
